programs.title: Direct Entry Graduate
programs.summary: If you meet the University of Wisconsin-Stout’s entry requirements, you can enrol directly into your chosen undergraduate or graduate degree and start gaining real-world experience from your very first day.

description: UW-Stout is based in Menomonie, Wisconsin – a safe, welcoming college town just over an hour from Minneapolis–Saint Paul. Students enjoy an affordable cost of living, a close-knit community, and access to one of the Midwest’s most dynamic business regions, home to global employers and internship opportunities.
